simulated.simulator: hand-written scenario and the EXR-01 model in tools/hslsa/rot.go
simulated.standsIn: the root of trust vendor's fab, sort, packaging and final test, and the EXR-01 part itself, whose die identity from wafer sort is a software model of a DICE engine

note: The root of trust vendor's lot at Wafer L3 and Package/Test L3: every passing die gets an identity at wafer sort, endorsed by the vendor's identity CA, and the part's ROM uses it as its IDevID. EXR-01 is a simulated part whose die is the PicoRV32 example's design under another name; everything about it that makes it a root of trust (secure-boot ROM, UDS, DICE identity, firmware) is modeled in tools/hslsa/rot.go.

deviceIdentity.serial: per unit; the shipped lot lists every unit's identity certificate digest

identity.ca: Example RoT Co EXR-01 IDevID CA
